data.name: Hw_Subtitle
data.value: Detailed overview of your detected hardware

data.name: Hw_RefreshTip
data.value: Run the full hardware detection again. This takes about 5 seconds.

data.name: Hw_ElevationBanner
data.value: Running without administrator rights: some values (temperatures, SMART health) are not available.

data.name: Hw_ElevationBannerNote
data.value: Processor, memory, display and system detection remains fully available.

data.name: Hw_ElevationHelpTip
data.value: Open GameBoost settings, which offer to relaunch the application with administrator rights

data.name: Hw_PeripheralSearchTip
data.value: Filter the displayed peripherals by name or type

data.name: Hw_OpenGpuPageTip
data.value: Open the GPU page: supported technologies, driver and live measurements

data.name: Hw_CoresThreadsTip
data.value: A core is a processing unit of the CPU; threads let each core handle two tasks at once.

data.name: Hw_ClockTip
data.value: The processor's operating frequency, expressed in megahertz (MHz).

data.name: Hw_UsageTip
data.value: Share of memory in use: total minus available.

data.name: Hw_BiosTip
data.value: BIOS version and date as reported by the motherboard manufacturer.

data.name: Hw_SerialTip
data.value: Local identifier of the motherboard, never sent outside your PC.

data.name: Hw_UptimeTip
data.value: How long the PC has been on without a restart.

data.name: Hw_GameModeTip
data.value: Windows setting that prioritizes games in the background. The displayed value is read from the registry.

data.name: Hw_DirectXTip
data.value: The graphics interface used by games. DirectX 12 is the current version on recent Windows.

data.name: Hw_ElevatedTip
data.value: GameBoost is running with administrator rights.

data.name: Hw_NotElevatedTip
data.value: Without administrator rights, temperatures and SMART health cannot be read.

data.name: Hw_PrimaryTip
data.value: The display used as the main screen by Windows.

data.name: Hw_RefreshRateTip
data.value: Number of images the display shows per second.

data.name: Hw_PeripheralKindTip
data.value: The peripheral type as classified by Windows.

data.name: Gpu_Subtitle
data.value: Graphics card, driver, live measurements and supported technologies

data.name: Gpu_RefreshTip
data.value: Run graphics card detection again. This takes about 5 seconds.

data.name: Gpu_EmptyNote
data.value: Detection returned no graphics card model. This happens when Windows uses a generic display driver, or when reading the registry failed. No value is made up: nothing will be shown until detection has a result.

data.name: Gpu_EmptyRefreshTip
data.value: Run hardware detection again to get the exact graphics card model

data.name: Gpu_LiveNote
data.value: Sampled automatically, about once per second.

data.name: Gpu_TempTip
data.value: Temperature of the graphics processor. Reading it requires administrator rights; the hotspot is the hottest spot on the silicon.

data.name: Gpu_LoadTip
data.value: The share of the graphics card's capacity used by games and applications.

data.name: Gpu_ClockTip
data.value: The graphics processor's current frequency, in megahertz. It varies with load and temperature.

data.name: Gpu_FanTip
data.value: The card's fan speed, as a percentage of its maximum speed.

data.name: Gpu_VramUsedTip
data.value: Video memory used by current textures and images, sampled continuously.

data.name: Gpu_VramTotalTip
data.value: The amount of dedicated video memory reported by the card's driver.

data.name: Gpu_TechNote
data.value: GameBoost detects hardware compatibility. Activation happens in the games or the vendor's control panel (GeForce Experience / AMD Software).

data.name: Gpu_AdaptersNote
data.value: Every graphics card visible to Windows, including integrated chips.

data.name: Gpu_DriverAgeTip
data.value: A very old driver can reduce performance in recent games.

data.name: Gpu_DriverTip
data.value: The driver links Windows to the graphics card. An up-to-date driver fixes bugs and unlocks features.

data.name: Gpu_DedicatedVramTip
data.value: Physical video memory installed on the card, separate from the PC's system memory.

data.name: Gpu_PnpIdTip
data.value: The card's technical identifier in Windows, used to find the right driver.

data.name: Gpu_TechDlss
data.value: AI image reconstruction: the image is rendered at a lower resolution then enhanced, which raises FPS in supported games.

data.name: Gpu_TechFrameGen
data.value: AI-generated in-between frames to smooth the display. It depends on the card's generation and on games that support it.

data.name: Gpu_TechRayTracing
data.value: Simulates real light: more accurate reflections, shadows and lighting, at the cost of a higher rendering workload.

data.name: Gpu_TechReflex
data.value: Reduces the delay between your mouse or controller input and the displayed image. Mostly useful in competitive gaming.

data.name: Gpu_TechFsr
data.value: Upscaling image enhancement, available on many graphics cards. It is configured in supported games.

data.name: Gpu_TechXess
data.value: AI image enhancement, usable in games that support it.

data.name: Gpu_CompatibleTip
data.value: Compatibility is inferred from the detected graphics card model.

data.name: Gpu_PrimaryTip
data.value: This adapter drives the main display.

data.name: Gpu_VendorPciTip
data.value: Vendor identified from the driver's PCI identifier.

data.name: Gpu_OtherVendorTip
data.value: The vendor could not be matched to NVIDIA, AMD or Intel.

data.name: Gpu_UnknownVendorTip
data.value: The vendor could not be identified.

data.name: Sto_Subtitle
data.value: Free space, SMART status and temperatures of your drives

data.name: Sto_RefreshTip
data.value: Run the full drive analysis again: temperatures, SMART health and a test transfer. About 3 seconds.

data.name: Sto_LoadingNote
data.value: The analysis takes up to 3 seconds: it reads SMART counters and measures a test transfer.

data.name: Sto_Tip1
data.value: Below 10% free space, Windows and games run out of room for updates and caches: downloads fail or slow down.

data.name: Sto_Tip2
data.value: An SSD filled above 90% loses performance: keep some free headroom, especially on the drive that holds Windows.

data.name: Sto_Tip3
data.value: Temperatures and SMART status are only read with administrator rights: without them, these values show as not available.

data.name: Sto_Tip4
data.value: These lines describe normal storage behaviour. GameBoost never modifies your drives.

data.name: Sto_AlertNote
data.value: Windows and games need space for updates and caches.

data.name: Sto_AlertTipCritical
data.value: Tip: uninstall unneeded applications, empty the Recycle Bin, then move your games to another drive.

data.name: Sto_AlertTipWarning
data.value: Tip: move your games to another drive or uninstall what you no longer use before Windows runs out of space.

data.name: Sto_OpenExplorerTip
data.value: Open File Explorer at the root of the volume concerned

data.name: Sto_SystemDiskTip
data.value: The drive that holds Windows and its boot files.

data.name: Sto_BusTypeTip
data.value: How the drive connects to the rest of the PC.

data.name: Sto_CapacityTip
data.value: The total space advertised by the drive.

data.name: Sto_TemperatureTip
data.value: The drive's temperature measured during the analysis. Without administrator rights, this reading is impossible.

data.name: Sto_HealthTipNa
data.value: Status reported by the drive. The detailed health percentage requires administrator rights.

data.name: Sto_HealthTipKnown
data.value: Health estimated from the wear reported by the drive: 100% means a brand-new drive.

data.name: Sto_SpeedsTip
data.value: Speed observed during the analysis: a short, indicative measurement, it does not replace a full performance test.

data.name: Sto_OpenRootDisabledTip
data.value: This drive has no drive letter: it cannot be opened directly in File Explorer.

data.name: Sto_OpenRootTip
data.value: Open File Explorer at the root of {0}

data.name: Sto_UsedPercent
data.value: {0}% of the volume is in use.

data.name: Sto_TempBadgeTip
data.value: The drive's temperature during the analysis. A flash drive usually stays below 50 °C.

data.name: Sto_SsdTip
data.value: Flash drive with no moving parts: fast and silent access.

data.name: Sto_HddTip
data.value: Mechanical drive with spinning platters: slower and noisier.

data.name: Sto_MediaUnknownTip
data.value: Windows did not report the type of this drive.
